nodes.label: QuantumQA: Physics-Consistent Dataset and Verification-Aware Reinforcement Learning
nodes.author: Songxin Qu et al.
nodes.rationale: Proposes QuantumQA dataset (92,749 samples) with hybrid verification protocol and VRM for RLVR to improve LLM reliability in quantum mechanics through verifiable, rule-based feedback.

nodes.label: QuantumQA Dataset
nodes.rationale: Large-scale dataset of 92,749 quantum mechanics samples with task-adaptive construction and hybrid verification (deterministic + semantic + HITL).

nodes.label: Verification-Aware Reward Model (VRM)
nodes.rationale: Unified reward model combining deterministic verification signals from SES with multidimensional semantic evaluation (Corr, Phys, Inst) via adaptive reward fusion for RLVR.

nodes.label: Scientific Execution Suite (SES)
nodes.rationale: Deterministic toolkit with 12 modular verification scripts for mathematical and physical consistency checks using SymPy, QuTiP, and symbolic solvers.

nodes.label: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR)
nodes.rationale: RL paradigm using deterministic execution signals and semantic evaluation for precise supervision in scientific reasoning, demonstrated via PPO and GRPO.

nodes.label: Hybrid Verification Protocol
nodes.rationale: Two-layer filtering: automated verification via SES and auxiliary critic, followed by HITL audit with dynamic rejection threshold (τ>5%) for dataset quality.

nodes.label: Task-Adaptive Data Construction
nodes.rationale: Strategy enforcing concise answers for retrieval tasks and rigorous CoT for complex reasoning, mitigating hallucination through task-specific response structure.

nodes.label: Adaptive Reward Fusion (ARF)
nodes.rationale: Mechanism dynamically modulating supervision strength based on verifiability, fusing deterministic and semantic signals with dimension-wise weights.

nodes.label: Dynamic Weight Allocation (DWA) Head
nodes.rationale: Gating network estimating reliability weights based on execution results, enabling robust reward estimation under partial verification noise.

nodes.label: Oracle-Guided Pretraining
nodes.rationale: Supervised distillation from ensemble of oracles generating soft quality scores and dimension weights, eliminating information leakage via disjoint oracle models.

nodes.label: LLM-as-a-Judge Evaluation
nodes.rationale: Automated evaluation protocol using frontier models (Qwen3-Max) for semantic scoring, validated against human experts with Spearman ρ=0.82.

nodes.label: Best-of-N Sampling for Verification
nodes.rationale: Demonstrates VRM discriminative power: single-sample RLVR policy matches SFT with N=32 samples, validating verification signal distillation into policy.

nodes.label: Verbosity Bias Mitigation in RLVR
nodes.rationale: RLVR achieves superior accuracy with lowest token usage, negative correlation between length and quality, preventing reward hacking via reasoning loops.

nodes.label: Error Analysis: Logical/Physical Violations
nodes.rationale: Blind human evaluation on 100 samples: RLVR reduces logical violations from 41% (SFT) to 28%, improves accuracy from 48% to 62%.

nodes.label: Parameter Efficiency in Quantum Reasoning
nodes.rationale: VRM-optimized Qwen3-8B (0.680 Problem Solving) outperforms ChatGPT-5 (0.642) and DeepSeek-R1 (0.665), demonstrating parameter-efficient alternative to scaling.

nodes.label: Out-of-Distribution Generalization
nodes.rationale: RLVR consistently surpasses SFT on SuperGPQA and Physics benchmarks, indicating robust reasoning capabilities beyond source domain.

nodes.label: Complementarity of Deterministic and Semantic Verification
nodes.rationale: 31.6% of samples pass semantic but fail deterministic verification, demonstrating hybrid method rewards partial correctness while enforcing rigor.

nodes.label: Dimensional Analysis of Semantic Verification
nodes.rationale: Pass rates: Physical Consistency 68%, Mathematical Correctness 81.4%, Instruction Following 92.6%, identifying physical constraints as primary filter.

nodes.label: Expert Verification Pipeline
nodes.rationale: 15 domain experts (10 PhD candidates, 5 postdocs) with custom annotation interface, standardized 4-metric evaluation, IRB approval, fair compensation.

nodes.label: Seed-Evolve Paradigm
nodes.rationale: Data construction strategy expanding topical breadth from authoritative seed problems via hierarchical decomposition and heterogeneous model ensemble generation.

nodes.label: Semantic Deduplication Threshold
nodes.rationale: Cosine similarity threshold Υ=0.85 using all-MiniLM-L6-v2 encoder to eliminate redundancy and ensure dataset diversity.

nodes.label: Boundary Mutation Strategy
nodes.rationale: Generates adjacent problems by altering boundary conditions and physical constraints, testing model robustness to subtle logical shifts.

nodes.label: Adversarial Response Generation
nodes.rationale: Dual-track prompting with standard and adversarial instructions across model ensemble (lightweight to frontier), generating 3 responses per track per question.

nodes.label: Parser-Executor Pipeline in SES
nodes.rationale: Three-stage pipeline: semantic parsing via LLM, type casting and parameter passing, execution with exception handling for robust verification.
